identity.name: Scorpion Magazine
identity.summary: A segmented brass arrow cradle ending in a curved tail.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 1 arrows, 2 poison to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
identity.lore: A patient engineer watched a desert scorpion for seven years.
